lines: This triple orb from bare resolve alone bears fruit —
who gauges, Lord, the orbit of thy workings?
sanskrit_cite: icchāyā eva yasyeyat phalaṃ lokatrayātmakam tasya te nātha kāryāṇāṃ ko vetti kiyatī gatiḥ

lines: Up rung by rung even Brahmā troops with the rest,
thy stairway scaled, to lodge — to him I bend.
sanskrit_cite: brahmādayo 'pi tad yasya karmasopānamālayā upary upari dhāvanti labdhuṃ dhāma namāmi tam

lines: 'Lo Brahmā, lo Indra, lo sun and moon' — thy tendril
in flower: Bhava, that one, be our ward.
sanskrit_cite: ayaṃ brahmā mahendro 'yaṃ sūryācandramasāv imau iti śaktilatā yasya puṣpitā pātv asau bhavaḥ

lines: No craze can catch him, though minds craze; far feet
ne'er gain his bourne — hard wold at evenfall: praise Mild.
sanskrit_cite: bhramo na labhyate yasya bhrāntāntaḥkaraṇair api dūragair api yasyānto durgam astaṃ stumo mṛḍam
notes: astaṃ kept setting per T1/argmap; home/abode needs M00089, left open

lines: In hymn and heed, in muse, in sight, in touch, in advent teeming —
to Bliss-bulk, to Beloved, to Braid-crowned: hail.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine

lines: 'Why this vaunt?' — mused in heart, O Sovereign Height —
'vaunting, I am thine-made' — ah me, unselfed: what glee?
sanskrit_cite: kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara smayena tvanmayo 'smīti māmi nātmani kiṃ mudā
notes: māmi parsing unknown, kept me-? per T1/argmap; needs M00089 collation

lines: Counted crores of charges, through fancy's flicker —
I pause, Bhava, and banquet deep in mind-joy of thee.
sanskrit_cite: cintayitvāpi kartavyakoṭīś cittasya cāpalāt viśrāmyan bhava bhāvatkacittānande rame bhṛśam

lines: Fine though thou be, how is tri-world thy splinter?
Gross though thou be, why do Firstborn and kin miss thee plain?
sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmo 'pi cet trilokīyaṃ kalāmātraṃ kathaṃ tava sthūlo 'tha kiṃ sudarśo na brahmādibhir api prabho

lines: Had 'thee alone speaks all' ne'er rung — what sage
had wrangled, God, through wordy snares then?
sanskrit_cite: vācya eṣāṃ tvam eveti nābhaviṣyad idaṃ yadi kaḥ kleśaṃ deva vāgjāleṣv akariṣyat sudhīs tadā

lines: Through what drill, what rite, what lore art thou descried, O Master —
lesson me, and let thy favour light on me.
sanskrit_cite: krameṇa karmaṇā kena kayā vā prajñayā prabho dṛśyo 'sīty upadeśena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama

lines: To the Unserved who serves the threefold singly,
to all men's darling who desires nought, to Tangle-locks — hail.
sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine

lines: Lo, the saints' field-sense for high emprise —
whereby these sow deathless-fruited love in thee, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho

lines: Ah, ample thy glamour, O Trickster, wherein shrouded
the dazed delay though thought's hoard on thee be gained.
sanskrit_cite: mahatīyam aho māyā tava māyin yayāvṛtaḥ tvaddhyānanidhilābhe 'pi mugdho lokaḥ ślathāyate

lines: At each emprise, Bhava — deed, tool, cosmos be as they be —
the unbound maker there is thee alone.
sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

lines: Clutched by tri-strand triple-throb twins, the triple spheres —
to haul them, save thee, whose force, whose ruth?
sanskrit_cite: triguṇatriparispandadvandvagrastaṃ jagattrayam uddhartuṃ bhavato 'nyasya kasya śaktiḥ kṛpāthavā

lines: What taint is taint in souls set to attain thee, e'en Lord?
What worth is worth, pray, in souls set never to attain? Be passion mine, world-Lord, on thee alone reposed — yea, homage to my greed, leashed to gain of thee.
sanskrit_cite: doṣo 'pideva ko doṣas tvām āptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ guṇo 'pi ca guṇaḥ ko nu tvāṃ nāptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ rāgo 'py astu jagannātha mama tvayy eva yaḥ sthitaḥ lobhāyāpi namas tasmai tvallābhālambanāya me

lines: Ah, mighty this observance, God — brooding thee throughout:
therein, from Firstborn to grub, who lacks title to release?
sanskrit_cite: aho mahad idaṃ karma deva tvadbhāvanātmakam ābrahmakrimi yasmin no muktaye 'dhikriyeta kaḥ

lines: Alpha of all deeds, omega of all rites, the motley midst between —
thine indeed, O Master, on wit's highway.
sanskrit_cite: ārambhaḥ sarvakāryāṇām paryantaḥ sarvakarmaṇām tadantarvṛttayaś citrās tavaiveśo dhiyaḥ pathi

lines: While higher swells the thousandfold tide of savour —
past love-juice for thee, Lord, nowhere is it found.
sanskrit_cite: yāvad uttaram āsvādasahasraguṇavistaraḥ tvadbhaktirasapīyūṣān nātha nānyatra dṛśyate
